name: Irish Film Festival Berlin (St Patrick's Film Festival)
description: Celebrate Irish cinema in Berlin on the weekend before St. Patrick's Day with a curated selection of films, documentaries and visual art shorts. The festival will feature traditional live music on Saturday when Babylon will be bathed in green light. A timely celebration as Irish talent—from Cillian Murphy to Paul Mescal to Barry Keoghan—dominates the international film stage. Come for the films, stay for the craic.
